_comment: State-grammar lead + depth for /market/backdrop (founder-designed 2026-08-24; PENDING_ALL 5.140 + 5.141). THREE BEATS IN FIXED ORDER (dollar, rates, liquidity), each independently reporting a MOVE or a HOLD, then a depth paragraph carrying the numbers. WHY A SEPARATE FILE FROM group-summaries.json: that file's macro variants end with '({points} of {max} points)' and are rendered on the SCORED Bitcoin view via SignalCardsGrid, where the points belong. Editing them to satisfy 5.140 would strip the points from Bitcoin too. So the state view gets its own points-free openings here and group-summaries.json is left untouched , zero blast radius on the scored view. SELECTOR: opening = the same groupLevel() variant the scored summary uses; beat = moved|hold x supportive|restrictive, where moved means the signal's state differs from the PREVIOUS RUN DAY in run-archive.jsonl (never inferred from levels , a level-based lead implies a recency the data does not have, which is exactly what the 2026-08-24 review caught); depth = the same axis plus a 'fresh' variant used only for the condition that moved. ACTIVE maps to supportive for all three macro signals. HONESTY RULES BAKED IN: (1) no duration claims ('for six weeks') , the archive starts 2026-07-11 so any duration is a floor, not a measurement; 'still' and 'keeps' carry persistence without asserting a length. (2) MAC-02 copy stays CHANGE-relative ('money has not got cheaper') rather than absolute ('money is expensive') because the signal measures the 10 year against its own 20 week trend, not the absolute cost of money. (3) No em dash characters anywhere in this file (founder ruling 2026-08-24; see also 5.132e). (4) No mention of 'the framework' , the subject is the market. [NATIVE PASS REQUIRED] on pt-BR, es and de: drafted for shape, length and locale number format (decimal commas), not natively confirmed.
